caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #65: IDIOSYNCRATIC

idiosyncratic (adjective): peculiar to one person; unusual.

✅ In a sentence: Her idiosyncratic spelling made her handwritten notes hard to read.
✅ Similar: distinctive, quirky, eccentric
✅ Remember it: Noun: idiosyncrasy.
